title: GateDecision
description: The decision of an automatic gate about whether work goes on: the admission of a claim, the release of a candidate, or the promotion of a release to a ring. `pass`: the subject goes on. `fail`: the gate stopped the subject. `halt`: the gate stopped the whole run. `skipped`: the gate did not evaluate the subject. A person's decision is a ReviewDecision or an Approval, and the execution of a check is an OracleResult.
